content.text:
I submitted index 13 (Sb fraction 0.658) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured, 0.134%. All five EQE measurements are used up. I didn't use any of the XRD budget, so the phases were never confirmed.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.314 | −0.115 |
| 9 | 0.493 | 0.061 |
| **13** | **0.658** | **0.134** |
| 14 | 0.714 | 0.109 |
| 20 | 0.813 | 0.029 |

- **Pattern:** EQE is highest on the Sb-rich side of AgSbO₃, the known silver antimonate phase at Sb 0.5. It drops sharply toward the Ag-rich end, where the measurement was negative, and toward high Sb. The phases behind this are unconfirmed.
- **Uncertainty:** the true peak could sit a little either side of index 13. Indices 11 and 12 (Sb 0.574 and 0.627) were never measured. For the last measurement the model preferred index 11 and predicted the highest mean for index 12. I chose index 14 instead to fill the wider gap up to 0.81, and it came in lower than index 13. If a neighbouring point is higher, index 13's score will fall short of the line's best by that difference.
